total_model.summary: Model projects 44.0 total points (SEA 24, CHI 20). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 1.6), Combined defense EPA allowed/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 1.2), Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 1.1). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
